prompt:
A THREE-PANEL horizontal strip of equal panels on warm cream paper, separated by clean cream gutters with no drawn borders or frame lines. One continuous world, the same cast and the same glowing amber laptop in all three panels, reading left to right as one argument.

THE HUMAN, identical in all three panels: a woman in her thirties with short dark curly hair, wearing a plain charcoal crew-neck sweater. She sits in a warm room at a desk, outside the glowing translucent amber laptop. She never reaches into the screen.

INSIDE the laptop screen in every panel: the Chief of Agents, a rounded character in a gold military cap, and a smaller plain sub-agent. The concept happens inside the screen; the woman stays outside it.

BEAT ONE: Inside the screen, a tall bank of open drawers stands wide open and the Chief of Agents has both arms plunged deep into them, loose blank sheets flying out and scattering. Outside, the woman has one hand half-raised, hesitant, unable to tell what he is touching.

BEAT TWO: Inside the screen, the same bank of drawers is now shut and stands behind a plain counter with a SINGLE lever handle on it. The Chief of Agents has one hand resting on the lever and holds up one small blank card in front of it, showing it before he pulls. The sub-agent stands beside him watching the card. Outside, the woman leans in, calm, reading the card.

BEAT THREE: Inside the screen, an open book rests on a small stand beside the counter. A NEW sub-agent has just arrived and walks straight past the closed drawers to the counter, one hand out toward the lever. The Chief of Agents stands back with his arms at his sides. Outside, the woman sits back in her chair, hands in her lap.

ALL WRITABLE SURFACES ARE BLANK: the flying sheets, the small card, the open book and the counter carry NO lettering, NO words, NO symbols and NO numbers. There are no signs anywhere in the scene, no labels on the drawers, and no signage on the walls.

TEXT FURNITURE, in the cream margins only, never over the artwork, rendered character-exact and in capitals:
TITLE BAR above the panels: GIVE THE AGENT A CLI
CAPTION under panel one: HANDS IN THE DRAWERS
CAPTION under panel two: ONE HANDLE, ONE PREVIEW
CAPTION under panel three: WRITTEN DOWN, SO IT IS FOUND
FOOTER BAR below the panels: NAME THE OPERATION. THEN IT CAN BE TESTED.

ABSOLUTELY NOT: a denim jacket, a jean jacket, any chest patch, any smiley-face badge, any enamel pin, any embroidered emblem, a white tee under an open jacket. No recurring branded character and no identifiable real individual. No neon, no 3D or CGI or Pixar look, no glossy plastic, no HUD or arc-reactor comic vocabulary.

warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults

Do NOT render it in any of these styles: comic-book, cartoon mascot, flat vector, neon, 3D/CGI/Pixar, photoreal, anime, any identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
